969class Device: 

970 """Represent a GPU and act as an entry point for cuda.core features. 

971  

972 This is a singleton object that helps ensure interoperability 

973 across multiple libraries imported in the process to both see 

974 and use the same GPU device. 

975  

976 While acting as the entry point, many other CUDA resources can be 

977 allocated such as streams and buffers. Any :obj:`~_context.Context` dependent 

978 resource created through this device, will continue to refer to 

979 this device's context. 

980  

981 Newly returned :obj:`~_device.Device` objects are thread-local singletons 

982 for a specified device. 

983  

984 Note 

985 ---- 

986 Will not initialize the GPU. 

987  

988 Parameters 

989 ---------- 

990 device_id : int, optional 

991 Device ordinal to return a :obj:`~_device.Device` object for. 

992 Default value of `None` return the currently used device. 

993  

994 """

998 "_has_inited", 

999 "_properties", 

1000 "_resources", 

1001 "_uuid", 

1002 "_context", 

1003 "__weakref__", 

1004 )

1077 def can_access_peer(self, peer: Device | int) -> bool: 

1078 """Check if this device can access memory from the specified peer device. 

1079  

1080 Queries whether peer-to-peer memory access is supported between this 

1081 device and the specified peer device. 

1082  

1083 Parameters 

1084 ---------- 

1085 peer : Device | int 

1086 The peer device to check accessibility to. Can be a :obj:`~_device.Device` object or device ID. 

1087 """ 

1088 peer = Device(peer) 

1089 cdef int d1 = <int> self.device_id 

1090 cdef int d2 = <int> peer.device_id 

1091 if d1 == d2: 

1092 return True 

1093 cdef int value = 0 

1094 with nogil: 

1095 HANDLE_RETURN(cydriver.cuDeviceCanAccessPeer(&value, d1, d2)) 

1096 return bool(value)
